name: Signals and Systems
description: Classifications of signals and systems and their properties, time-domain representation of LTI system, signal space and geometric concepts, Fourier analysis of continuous-time signals and systems, sampling and reconstruction of band-limited signals, Fourier analysis of discrete-time signals and systems, introduction to DFT, Laplace transform, Z transform, applications of signals and systems in filtering/communications/control/stochastic-processes.
